narration.en: Open any phone charger and you will find more resistors than any other part. They set currents, divide voltages and protect LEDs and transistors.

body.en: A resistor is specified by its resistance value, tolerance (allowed deviation, e.g. ±5 %), power rating (largest power it can dissipate safely, e.g. ¼ W) and temperature coefficient. Fixed resistors include carbon composition, carbon film, metal film (low noise, close tolerance) and wire-wound (high power, made of nichrome or manganin wire).
body.kn: ರೋಧಕವನ್ನು ರೋಧ ಮೌಲ್ಯ, ಸಹಿಷ್ಣುತೆ, ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ದರ ಮತ್ತು ತಾಪ ಗುಣಾಂಕದಿಂದ ಗುರುತಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಸ್ಥಿರ ರೋಧಕಗಳು: ಕಾರ್ಬನ್ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆ, ಕಾರ್ಬನ್ ಪದರ, ಲೋಹ ಪದರ ಮತ್ತು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ತಂತಿ ಸುತ್ತಿದ ರೋಧಕ.

points.en: Tolerance: ± percentage of the marked value
Power rating: P = I²R must stay below it
Wire-wound: high power; metal film: precision

say.en: Every resistor carries three numbers: its value, its tolerance and its power rating.
Tolerance is the allowed error. 5 percent of 4700 is 235 ohms, so the real value lies between 4465 and 4935 ohms.
The power rating sets the safe current. From P equals I squared R, the largest current is about 10 milliamperes.
Types: wire-wound for high power, metal film for low noise and close tolerance, carbon film for general use.
Special resistors change with conditions. An NTC thermistor’s resistance falls steeply as it gets hotter; an LDR’s falls in bright light.

narration.en: Sort each resistor: fixed value, varied by hand, or changed by light or temperature.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ರೋಧಕವನ್ನು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ: ಸ್ಥಿರ, ಕೈಯಿಂದ ಬದಲಿಸುವ, ಅಥವಾ ಬೆಳಕು/ತಾಪದಿಂದ ಬದಲಾಗುವ.

text.en: Potentiometer used as a volume control

explanation.en: Carbon composition, carbon film, metal film and wire-wound resistors have a fixed value. Potentiometers, rheostats and presets are adjusted by hand. An LDR falls in resistance in bright light; an NTC thermistor falls and a PTC thermistor rises as temperature rises.

body.en: A potentiometer has three terminals and a sliding wiper; used as a volume control it divides voltage. A rheostat uses two terminals to vary current. Presets (trimmers) are set once with a screwdriver. A light dependent resistor (LDR) has lower resistance in brighter light. A thermistor changes resistance with temperature: NTC types fall in resistance as temperature rises, PTC types rise.
body.kn: ಪೊಟೆನ್ಶಿಯೋಮೀಟರ್ ಮೂರು ತುದಿಗಳ ಚರ ರೋಧಕ; ರಿಯೋಸ್ಟಾಟ್ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಬದಲಿಸಲು. ಬೆಳಕು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದಂತೆ LDR ನ ರೋಧ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. NTC ಥರ್ಮಿಸ್ಟರ್‌ನ ರೋಧ ತಾಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದಂತೆ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, PTC ಯದು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: LDR: R falls as light increases
NTC: R falls as temperature rises; PTC: R rises

aim.en: To find the equivalent resistance of two resistors joined in series and in parallel. Try this: Measure two resistors on their own and then joined in series and in parallel. Check that each measured value lies within the resistor's tolerance band.
aim.kn: ಸರಣಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದ ಎರಡು ರೋಧಕಗಳ ಸಮಾನ ರೋಧ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯುವುದು. ಇದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ: ಎರಡು ರೋಧಕಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ, ನಂತರ ಸರಣಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಅಳೆಯಿರಿ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಳತೆ ರೋಧಕದ ಸಹಿಷ್ಣುತಾ ಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಇದೆಯೇ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.
